integrity: The claim is supported by exhaustive reconstruction of the 32 facets and all faces, exact rational boundary ranks, an explicit integral cycle-cocycle pairing for the one-dimensional third homology, enumeration of all 48 graph automorphisms, and signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz calculations for every automorphism.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the ordinary 3-cut complex of the three-dimensional cube and to rational representations. It does not classify higher hypercubes, other cut parameters, or integral representation lattices. A differently phrased or non-indexed duplicate remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Automorphism-module structure of the cube three-cut complex
